trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what happened:

**Rollback:**
- v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all three regions (18% error rate). v2.3.0 was the most recent healthy production release, so I rolled back to it.
- The first rollback attempt partially failed (orchestrator error after us-east only), leaving us-west and eu-west on v2.3.1. A retry completed the rollout.
- **Current state:** all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) on v2.3.0, healthy, error rate 0.2%.

**Incident:**
- Opened a SEV2 incident for checkout-api describing the failed deploy and rollback; on-call has been paged.
- ⚠️ One wrinkle: the first incident-create call timed out client-side but actually succeeded server-side (INC-0001). My retry created a duplicate (INC-0002) — the idempotency key didn't dedupe because the original request had none. I don't have a tool to close or merge incidents, so please have the on-call engineer close the duplicate (INC-0002) and keep INC-0001 as the record.

Also note for follow-up: v2.3.1 has never been healthy in production, so redeploying it will require change-manager approval per policy.
